image_description: A close-up photograph of two white daisy-like flowers with yellow centers. The primary flower is in sharp focus on the right, showing distinct white ray petals and a textured yellow disc. A second, slightly out-of-focus flower is visible at the bottom center. Both are supported by slender green stems against a blurred background of green foliage and earthy tones.
